activity_summary: Sam croaked like a rook on the cuckoo and Phillips stopped him. There was no second try. You told Sam the word was still his when the throat allowed, and you did not name anyone else for it. Arthur kept his own place and the split hooks. Kemp was told not to make a jig of the croak. The door stayed dark, with two days to go. Nobody was told a second plan.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused a second try's audience, and named no other boy.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Stopped Sam at the croak and kept him out of the song.

entities.name: Sam Latchet
entities.context: Croaked, asked for one more, and accepted dumb.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Counted two days, refused a surgery, and sent the morning home.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Wanted a house and not a rook, and was told the throat was not a jig.

entities.name: Arthur Meeks
entities.context: Kept his place, reported the hooks still split, and did not take the word.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Locked the one book and refused a new end.

quotes.speaker: sam_latchet
quotes.text: It will clear. Give me one more.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: His throat is not a jig.
